question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?

trace.query: SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page = 2 AND (text ILIKE '%overpotential%' OR text ILIKE '%19 to 12%' OR text ILIKE '%mV%') ORDER BY line_no
